title: 줄다리기
mood: rowdy, sweaty and far too competitive
subject: a company sports day where the sales department head takes the tug-of-war far too seriously for a prize of one pack of toilet paper
caption: Traditional Korean ska with a full horn section, upbeat and fast. An upstroke guitar skank on every off-beat; a Hammond organ doubling the off-beat skank in short percussive chops; a melodic electric bass walking under the verses; a four-piece horn section of trumpet, trombone, tenor sax and baritone sax playing unison riffs between the lines and a short trumpet solo; drums with rimshots on the backbeat, the hi-hat on the upbeats and a snare roll into each chorus. Roomy and live like a band on a club stage, horns wide, the voice and skank guitar forward. An easygoing male lead croon with a grin, and the band shouting the written group answers. 152 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, sweaty and far too competitive. No distorted punk guitars, no reggae one-drop slowdown, no pop drum machine, no rap, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - horn riff over the offbeat guitar skank]

[Verse 1]
토요일 아침 아홉 시 운동장
조끼 색깔은 영업팀 빨강
부장님 머리에 띠를 둘렀어
"이번엔 회계팀 꼭 이긴다"

[Pre-Chorus]
장갑 끼고 줄 잡아 (잡아!)
허리 낮춰 발 박아 (박아!)

[Chorus]
영차, 영차, 줄다리기
부장님 혼자 진심이야
상품은 휴지 한 묶음인데
얼굴이 벌써 빨개 (영차!)

[Verse 2]
첫 판은 졌어, 줄이 쭉 넘어가
부장님 운동화가 벗겨졌어
작전 타임에 화이트보드까지
"신입은 맨 뒤에서 버텨"

[Pre-Chorus]
줄을 감아 허리에 (허리에!)
하나 둘에 당겨 (당겨!)

[Chorus]
영차, 영차, 줄다리기
이젠 나도 진심이야
상품은 휴지 한 묶음인데
손바닥이 다 까졌어 (영차!)

[Bridge - trumpet solo over the skank]

[Outro - horns hit three times, then stop]
이겼다! 휴지는 부장님 차에
월요일엔 다들 허리 아파
